text:
Pavel Zacha is playing more than ever, 19:09 a night and over 20 minutes across his last ten, and the trade talk has followed him anyway. Daily Faceoff asked "What should the Bruins do with Pavel Zacha?" on Nov 14, and Causeway Crowd has run the case for moving him.

His 17 points in 21 games look fine. Our numbers are less sure. Boston has scored 5.6 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, which is padding his total, and on-ice luck like that fades. At five on five the Bruins take 52.3% of expected goals with him on but do slightly better without him.

His own chances have dipped too, 0.82 expected goals per 60 against 1.05 last season, when he scored 30. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him among the better forwards at reaching the home-plate area in front of the net last season, 86th percentile, so the question is whether he gets back there.

What to watch: if the bounces even out and the chances don't return, the trade chatter gets louder.
headline: Zacha's points are running ahead of the play
